title: Tetanus pure culture and serum therapy
summary: Kitasato first grew the tetanus bacillus in pure culture in 1889 and in 1890 worked with Emil von Behring on serum therapy for tetanus and diphtheria.
why: Founded antitoxin therapy, an early weapon against deadly infections.

unsung.contribution: Grew the tetanus bacillus in pure culture and co-developed antitoxin serum therapy.
unsung.recognition: Nominated for the first Nobel Prize in 1901, he was passed over; Behring received it alone.
